prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic soft-goth indoor selfie portrait.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult blonde woman with waist-length straight tousled hair, light green or hazel eyes, fair natural skin with freckles, and a dreamy upward gaze, wearing an opaque white bat-and-moon graphic top with a secure neckline and high-waisted dark trousers.
prompt.composition_elements: Eye-level slightly angled selfie, head gently tilted and chin raised, bedroom or living area, mystical beige tapestry, dark grey sofa, white shelving with woven bins, small purple plush object, orange accent, green houseplant, and tripod in the background.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused indoor light, hydrated natural skin finish, muted soft-goth palette, calm dreamy atmosphere, subtle realistic phone grain.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone portrait, natural proportions, realistic hair strands and fabric texture, shallow but readable background, subtle grain and dynamic range.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: An approved adult blonde woman with long straight waist-length hair, light green or hazel eyes, fair skin, rosy cheeks, faint freckles, and a dreamy contemplative gaze takes an eye-level angled selfie indoors. She wears an opaque white top printed with black bats, skeleton details, crescent moons, and stars, with a secure neckline and high-waisted dark trousers. Her head is slightly tilted and chin raised. The background shows a mystical beige tapestry, dark grey sofa, white shelving with woven storage bins, small purple and orange objects, a green leafy houseplant, and a tripod. Use soft diffused indoor lighting, natural skin and hair texture, muted soft-goth colors, and realistic phone grain.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, cropped camisole, low scoop neckline, exposed midriff, lingerie, transparent clothing, body-part emphasis, sexualized pose, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.
